title: Tier picker lists tiers by number and finds a number first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, whose name contains tier A's number (for example Fleet 7 when tier A is number 7).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  3. Open the Work Order Tier picker.
  4. Type tier A's number in the picker's search.
  5. Clear the picker's search.
  6. Type part of tier B's name in capitals.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • Edit Customer opens.

Step 3:

  • The picker lists the active tiers in number order, each as its number, " · " and its name, 1 · Default first.

Step 4:

  • Tier A is listed first.
  • Tier B follows, because its name contains the typed number.

Step 5:

  • Every active tier is listed again.

Step 6:

  • Tier B is listed, matched by its name in any letter case.
